steps.query:
ref rA
ref rG
Begin Function { }
let rA := GetFirstRef 200 1
while rA != 0
  if rA.GetSourceModIndex == 255
    if rA.GetDead == 0
      let rG := rA
    endif
  endif
  let rA := GetNextRef
loop
if rG
  rG.StartCombat player
endif
SetFunctionValue (GetFormIDString rG)
End
